body:
<!-- synopkgland:release:synopackageland%2FSynoPkgGopeed:0.2.2-0043 -->

Download Hub **0.2.2-0043**

0.2.2-0043
- Added AI and CLI operation through synopkgland ctl 0.15.0, under the gopeed alias.
- Commands cover task list/pause/resume, destination lookup, link and torrent submission, preparation status, search and result downloads.
- Keeps DSM App Privileges, per-user ownership and destination grants; sensitive URL/torrent/query inputs use standard writeOnly masking.
- Waiting for a submission confirms source preparation, not download/save completion. Existing executor approval is retained.

Package: `synopackageland/SynoPkgGopeed`
